announcements.text: Castelion Corp.*, Torrance, California, is awarded a $43,650,000 firm-fixed-price order (N6833526F1211) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N6833526G0006). This effort provides production support for the Blackbeard Hypersonic Weapon program under a Small Business Innovation Research Phase III delivery order. This contract is for the manufacturing, assembly, testing, and delivery of the first production lot of 444 All-Up Rounds (AURs), defined as fully functional tactical missiles packaged within specialized shipping and storage containers. The effort builds on prior Phase II and earlier Phase III work, including system integration, certification support, and delivery of pre-production prototype AURs in support of the Navy. Work will be performed in Rio Rancho, New Mexico (80%); and Torrance, California (20%), and is expected to be completed in September 2028. Fiscal 2025 weapons procurement, Navy funds in the amount of $44,000,000 will be obligated at the time of award. This contract action was not competed. announcements.text: MicroHealth LLC, Vienna, Virginia, is awarded $11,233,674 for a firm-fixed-price option modification (P00007) to a previously awarded task order (HT001123F0047) for Uniformed Services Family Health Plan data integration support services (USFHP DISS). The USFHP DISS task order provides information technology, data warehouse, and data processing support services to the Department of War for the designated provider healthcare delivery system in support of the Military Health System. Services include collecting designated provider data; interfacing with the Defense Enrollment and Eligibility Reporting System to obtain enrollment and eligibility data and transmit enrollment fee and catastrophic capitation information; reporting monthly enrollment and capitation results; maintaining designated provider enrollment demographics; and conducting audits, reviews, and data reconciliation. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds will be obligated to exercise and fully fund Option Three, contract line items 3001-3007, for the 12-month period from Sept. 27, 2026, through Sept. 26, 2027. The principal place of performance is Aurora, Colorado. The Defense Health Agency, Professional Services Contracting Division, Falls Church, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded Sept. 9, 2026.)
